title: OpenAI's Sol Doubles Its Input Price Past 272K Tokens
description:
GPT-6.1 Sol per 1M tokens: $2 in / $10 out up to 272K input tokens; above that $4 in / $15 out, cached input $0.10 to $0.20. Source: developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing
